description: Read the category rules, or pass rules to REPLACE the whole list. A plain match is a substring; a regex compiles only if it cannot backtrack exponentially. An empty match is refused. Free: 5 rules.

reapply_all.description: Also overwrite categories set by an earlier rule or by hand. Default false: only uncategorised transactions are touched

rules.description: The complete rule list; it replaces the stored one. Omit to list the current rules

match.description: Text to look for in the counterparty or description, e.g. "spotify"

regex.description: Treat match as a regular expression. A pattern that can backtrack exponentially is refused and used as a substring instead

name: category_rules
title: Set or list category rules
